name: Forcible Depredator
subtitle: move the thing...and...that other thing...move it!
rules: PLUNDER -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck'; catalog says 'an opponent's deck' (templating).

name: Fwing!
subtitle: fly, little brother! bring us back a shiny!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 speed. Flip a coin. If you win, the character also gains 1 strength this turn.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Grand Theft All
subtitle: should have locked the door
rules: Put up to 4 non-tactic cards in your opponent's discard pile into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating).

name: Hangdog Alley
subtitle: refuge of outcasts
rules: If an attacking party is formed, it must have only 1 member.
flavor: Its confusing design and plentiful exits make Hangdog Alley the perfect retreat for those wishing to avoid the law. Justice is handled by the locals and traitors are dealt with swiftly.
notes: Card prints 'If an attacking party is formed'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Hasty Sarcophyle
subtitle: he's hasty. and a sarcophyle.
flavor: Man, that is one hasty sarcophyle. Whoosh.

name: Headlong Purloiner
subtitle: you brought the woman too? bonus!
flavor: The great thing about Randy is that he really throws himself into whatever he does.

name: Heist Planner
subtitle: so cunning you could brush your teeth with it
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your opponent's deck for up to 3 cards with different names and reveal them. If you do, put them into your opponent's discard pile.
flavor: "You throw the paintings out of the window and we'll run by and pick them up."
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck/discard pile'; catalog 'an opponent's deck ... that player's discard pile' (templating).

name: Hollow Moose
subtitle: i think it's about a moose that turns invisible
rules: This card enters play under your opponent's control. -- At the start of your turn, your faction loses 1 influence. -- INFILTRATE -- COST – Destroy another item or character you control. -- EFFECT – Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor: ...and goes back in time for some reason.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog uses 'Pick an opponent ... That player' (templating).

name: Hulking Vigilante
subtitle: distributor of pain
rules: If you control any other characters you own, destroy this card.
flavor:
I am the terror that stalks in the street.
I am the dragon that lives in the slums.
I am the ogre that hammers the lawless.
I am the last thing you'll ever see.
notes: Card prints 'If you control...'; catalog 'When you control...' (templating). Flavor is four deliberate verse lines.

name: Hyperphagic Sarcophyle
subtitle: bottomless glutton of blood
rules: If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you may put a token on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
flavor: "The suave sarcophyle we know in society is a myth; if our young people really understood what these monsters become, if they could see the wake of tragedy and despair, they would never seek to convert." — Ernest Amdell, 'A Cancer in our Midst: On Sarcophelia and the Coming Plague'
notes: Card prints 'If this card inflicts damage...'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Impeccable Timing
subtitle: i'm sorry sandwich!
rules: COST – Pick a depleted character. -- EFFECT – If the character has 4 life or less, destroy it.
flavor: This happens more often than you'd think.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Impulsive Abductress
subtitle: take me! take me!
rules: KIDNAP -- COST – Destroy this card. Pick an attacking or blocking character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.
flavor:
A hearty lass, she sailed the seas
A queen of all things nautical
She snatched up men with wanton ease
Whene'er she felt erotical
notes: Flavor is a four-line verse.

name: Incriminating Photograph
subtitle: the wig is very slimming
rules: When this card enters play, name a non-resource card. -- The named card cannot be played.
flavor: Another photo in Dr. Unpeg Noon's distinct style.
notes: Card prints 'cannot be played'; catalog 'cannot be deployed' (updated terminology).

name: Jackmove
subtitle: he gets what he wants, even if it's yours
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X+X. -- EFFECT – Reveal up to the top X cards of your opponent's deck. Put all revealed characters and items into play under your control. Put the remaining cards into your opponent's discard pile.
flavor: "What do you mean you're Baron Unfigeld? The Baron arrived almost two hours ago! Oswaldo, throw this lunatic out onto the street at once."
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:'; card prints 'your opponent's deck/discard pile' vs catalog 'an opponent's ... that player's' (templating).

name: Late Addition
subtitle: am I interrupting?
rules: You may play a character card from your hand. Draw a card. (You still pay all the character's costs.)
notes: Card prints 'play a character card'; catalog 'deploy' (updated terminology). Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Sonny Liew'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: Martial Artist
subtitle: you suckers got nothing
rules: Your opponent cannot pick this card.
flavor: "Now are you boys gonna put down the weapons or do I have to keep embarrassing you..."
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot pick'; catalog 'Your opponents' (templating).

name: Martial Arts Master
subtitle: try? do or do not. there is no try.
rules: While this card is in a battle and there is at least one character in the opposing party, it gains X strength, where X is this card's speed minus the highest speed among characters in the opposing party.
flavor: "Judge me by my size, do you?"

name: Martial Arts Trainee
subtitle: stronger, faster, more powerful than before
rules: Your opponent cannot pick this card.
flavor: "Good! Now help me move this training dummy back into the storeroom."
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot pick'; catalog 'Your opponents' (templating).

name: Master Scavenger
subtitle: plundering where others fear to tread
rules: RECLAIM -- COST – Remove 3 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – This card gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: After the inhabitants pick the bones clean, they just throw the treasure away.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating).

name: Master Thief
subtitle: getting there is easy; getting away is the trick
rules: If this card is destroyed, you may pick a non-tactic card in your opponent's discard pile. If you do, put it into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is destroyed ... your opponent's discard pile'; catalog 'When ... an opponent's' (templating).

name: Mercenary's Creed
subtitle: a motivational orientation
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- BRIBE -- COST – Both players may use this ability. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Take control of the attached character. -- BLACKMAIL -- COST – Use this only if you own this card. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Take control of the attached character.
notes: Card prints 'Both players may use this ability'; catalog 'Any player' (templating, same in 2-player). Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box. 'Will work for' lettering is part of the artwork.

name: Misappropriation Machine
subtitle: we've got theftbots, pilfermajigs...
rules: STEAL -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character or item in your opponent's discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character or item into play under your control. Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor: ...and even a dusty old yoinkmotron.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile' / 'Your opponent takes control'; catalog 'an opponent's' / 'That card's owner takes control' (multiplayer templating, same in 2-player).

name: Orgy Den Smoke Out
subtitle: gold and finery, just slightly soiled
rules: Your opponent discards a card at random. Put the top 2 cards of their deck into their discard pile.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent'; catalog 'An opponent' (templating).

name: Pillaging Pirate
subtitle: so long, fatty!
rules: When this card enters play, put the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile.
flavor: Ogdred the Unreliable had been waiting for the right moment to start his own pirating franchise. An absent-minded order to carry the loot proved his perfect opportunity.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's deck'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating).

name: Pluck
subtitle: crafty exploiter of scenes
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- GRIFT -- COST – Use this only during your turn. Pay 5. Deplete this card. Pick a non-tactic card in your opponent's discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the card into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating).

name: Poisoned Blade
subtitle: looks good enough to eat
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- If the attached character inflicts damage to a character, destroy the damaged character. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: "Would you mind dipping those apples as well?"
notes: Card prints 'If the attached character inflicts damage'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Rapine
subtitle: you'll be coming with us now
rules: COST – Destroy a character or item you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the picked character.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Red Raven
subtitle: always calls "tails"
rules: If a coin is flipped, you may put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Card prints 'If a coin is flipped'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Scrag
subtitle: quick and painful
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is its life. -- EFFECT – If your opponent has at least X cards in their discard pile, destroy the character.
flavor: N.E.D.M. — Yeah, I know it's not timeless.
notes: Card checks 'your opponent' has at least X cards in their discard pile; catalog checks 'that character's controller' (changes whose discard pile is counted when targeting your own character). Also printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:'.

name: Snake Eyes
subtitle: take him away!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the character has received damage this turn, destroy it. Draw a card.
flavor: "Oh, too bad sir."
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Sudden Osprey
subtitle: who keeps a bird in a treasure chest?
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, it gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: "Honestly. A bird in a treasure chest."
notes: Card prints the TACTICAL ability as a sentence ('You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic'); catalog has the TACTICAL keyword. No threshold icons are printed on this image (catalog has dd), and the footer has no copyright line and no 2nd Edition logo (just 'COMMON 231/300').

name: Swashbuckler
subtitle: dashing seeker of danger
rules: When this card enters play, you may remove 4 cards in your opponent's discard pile from the game. If you don't, destroy this card.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's discard pile'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating).

name: The Billionaire
subtitle: always on the guest list
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- You may use abilities on your opponent's cards, but you must pay any numeric cost with your own resources. Any additional costs must be satisfied as though your opponent is using the ability. The ability's effect happens as if your opponent used it. -- CHANGE COSTUME -- COST – Pay 3. Shuffle this card into its owner's deck. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a "pluck" card with a different name than this card and reveal it. Put it into play under your control.
notes: Card puts quotes around "pluck".

name: Thief Doyen
subtitle: it's good to be the king
rules: COST – Discard a character or item. X is its numeric cost. -- This card enters play with X tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Tremor Engine
subtitle: enormous tool of mass plunder
rules: At the start of your turn, both players put the top 2 cards of their deck into their discard pile.
notes: Card prints 'both players'; catalog 'each player' (templating).

name: Two-Headed Coin
subtitle: fixing the odds
rules: If you lose a coin flip, you may shuffle this card into your deck. If you do, reflip that coin and draw a card instead.
flavor: "78 in a row. A new record, I imagine."
notes: Card says shuffle into 'your deck' (catalog: 'its owner's deck', differs for a card you control but don't own) and 'reflip that coin and draw a card instead' (catalog adds 'would lose' and 'use that result instead'; printed text does not say the new result is used). Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by FangWei'; 'Artist Series' watermark.

name: Unexpected Boobysnake
subtitle: nobody expects the unexpected boobysnake!
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, when this card enters play discard a card or destroy this card.
notes: Printed: discard-or-destroy applies whenever you played it using the tactic-timing permission ('If you do'). Catalog restricts it to 'if you deployed it during an opponent's turn', which differs when it is played at tactic timing during your own turn.

name: Vander Malagut
subtitle: seething hatred, seductive wit
rules: UNIQUE EVONDAN -- All your other "sarcophyle" characters gain 1 speed. -- If a character is destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, take control of that character instead. Reduce the amount of damage inflicted to it this turn to 0. It gains the "sarcophyle" subtype. -- If this card is destroyed, destroy all other "sarcophyle" characters.
notes: Card prints 'is destroyed ... damage inflicted'; catalog 'would be destroyed ... damage already inflicted' and 'When this card is destroyed' (replacement-effect/trigger templating, same play). Card quotes "sarcophyle".

name: Wild Boars
subtitle: freshly summoned from the abyss
rules: While this card is the only member of an attacking party, only characters with at least X speed can block it, where X is this card's speed.
flavor: "We should have ordered the chicken!"

name: Yoink!
subtitle: haugh haugh!
rules: COST – Pick a "gear" card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Take control of the "gear" card. Attach it to the character.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Arena Quarter-Finalist
subtitle: it's hard damn work being this good
flavor: Any rookie can swing a sword; mastery is about keeping your footing when the ring is thick with gore.

name: Assimilation Center
subtitle: these are lost drunken men who don't care
rules: "RECRUIT" -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a character and reveal it. Put it on the top of your deck.
flavor: "And these are lost drunken men who do care! And these are men who aren't lost and care, but don't drink."
notes: Ability name printed in quotes ("RECRUIT").

name: Barbaric Rifleman
subtitle: batter up!
rules: When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to your opponent's faction.
flavor: Every winter, the Imperial and Counter-Imperial armies compete against each other in the Metatropean Headball Championship Series. The amount of trash talk is unbelievable.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's faction'; catalog 'an opponent's' (templating). Footer reads 'limited edition artwork by Zi Jian'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: Bask Bile
subtitle: for the melting of troops and stuff
rules: COST – Pick a character or faction. -- EFFECT – Inflict 5 damage to the character or faction.
flavor: Available in french onion, barbeque ranch, or original nacho cheese flavor.
notes: Printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:' (updated templating).

name: Berserker Corps
subtitle: shhh...the screaming arouses them
rules: This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may pick a character you control. If you do, destroy it. Put X tokens on this card, where X is the destroyed character's strength when it was destroyed. Otherwise, destroy this card.
flavor: Got juice?

name: Bladefist Doomwing
subtitle: "Big McLargehuge" was already taken
rules: UNIQUE BLADEFIST -- FIREBREATHING -- COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X+X. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: Disciplining a barduse requires nerves of steel. A flame-retardant uniform comes in handy, too.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Kenfoo'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: Bloodcurdling Bulldozer
subtitle: as scary as he thinks he is
rules: If this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, deplete it.
flavor: "OHHH YEEEAAHHH!!!" — K.M.
notes: Card prints 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Blow Up
subtitle: and boom goes the dynamite
rules: COST – Pick an item. -- EFFECT – Destroy the item. Your opponent's faction loses 3 influence.
notes: Card says 'Your opponent's faction loses 3 influence'; catalog says 'That item's controller's faction loses 3 influence' (differs when the picked item is your own). Also printed 'COST –' vs catalog 'EXTRA COST:'.

name: Callow Liegeman
subtitle: hazing? do your worst.
rules: If this card attacks in a party with more than 1 member, it gains 1 strength and 1 life this turn.
flavor: You know if you stab a man in the dead of winter, steam will rise up from the wounds.
notes: Card prints 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).

name: Crazed Deputy
subtitle: a tad unstable
rules: If this card is blocked, it gains 2 strength and 2 life this turn.
flavor: "What do you mean my shoulder pads make me look like a dandy? RAR! blargity blarg BLARGH!"
notes: Card prints 'If this card is blocked'; catalog 'When ...' (templating).
